newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal steady, short-dated deposits up.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal steady, short-dated deposits up.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal was steady on the dollar this week in moderate trade focused on swaps but short-dated interbank deposit rates were higher, dealers said.
"Activity was moderate and focused on swaps. Short-dated rates climbed around 1/8 point, caused by tight liquidity in the market," one Riyadh-based dealer said.
The spot Saudi riyal was steady at 3.7506/08 to the dollar.
Spot-next and one-week funds were at 5-15/16, 13/16 percent. One-month deposit rates rose 1/16 point to 5-15/16, 13/16.
Three- and six-month and one-year maturities were unchanged at six, 5-7/8 percent, 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and 6-5/16, 3/16 percent respectively.
